name: @papra/app
description: Papra application package - document management system with year-based versioning.

scripts.build:docker:root:armv7: docker buildx build --platform linux/arm/v7 --target papra-root -t papra-local-root-armv7 -f ./Dockerfile.armv7 ../..
scripts.build:docker:rootless:armv7: docker buildx build --platform linux/arm/v7 --target papra-rootless -t papra-local-rootless-armv7 -f ./Dockerfile.armv7 ../..
